name: Old Kingdom
note: Dynasties 3-8; the age of the pyramids

name: Second Intermediate Period
note: Hyksos rule in the Nile Delta

name: Twenty-second Dynasty
note: Libyan dynasty founded by Shoshenq I (Shishak)

name: Twenty-sixth Dynasty
note: Saite pharaohs including Necho II and Apries (Hophra)

name: Early Dynastic Sumer
note: City-states such as Ur and Uruk

name: Neo-Hittite states
note: The Hittites of the books of Kings

name: Roman Empire
note: In the west to AD 476; the eastern empire continues as the Byzantine Empire

name: Xia dynasty
note: Traditional dates; its historicity is debated

name: Byzantine Empire
note: From the founding of Constantinople. Its people called it the Roman Empire to the end

name: Iran
note: The Islamic Republic, from the revolution of 1979

name: Republic of China
note: On the mainland; the Republic continues on Taiwan

name: Chola dynasty
note: The imperial Cholas; the dynasty is older

name: Abbasid Caliphate
note: At Baghdad until the Mongols sacked it in 1258; continued in Cairo under the Mamluks to 1517

name: Crusades
note: From Urban II's call in 1095 to the fall of Acre in 1291

name: Holy Roman Empire
note: From the coronation of Otto I; Charlemagne's empire (800) is often counted as its forerunner

name: Classic Maya
note: The Classic period of Maya civilization

name: Bar Kokhba revolt
note: Afterwards Hadrian refounded Jerusalem as Aelia Capitolina

name: The Holocaust
note: About six million Jews were murdered

name: Western Schism
note: Rival popes at Rome and Avignon

name: Reformation
note: Conventional end at the Peace of Westphalia

name: Masoretes
note: Scribes, chiefly at Tiberias, who added the vowels, accents and notes of the Hebrew text
